rows.grounds: compound with internal sandhi (siddhisaṃprāptiḥ + mūlakaulaṃ) identifying attainment of powers as the root Kaula

items.question: In what way is the attainment of eight powers identified as the root Kaula?
premises: The attainment of these powers is equated with the root Kaula.
The statement is addressed to the fair-faced goddess.
items.inference: The attainment of the eight powers constitutes the fundamental Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact scope of the eight powers is not enumerated in this verse.
items.plain_english: And the attainment of the eight powers is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
